selector.rationale: Necrobiosis Lipoidica best explains the clinical and pathological findings, including the presence of compact hyperkeratosis, epidermal atrophy, and bandlike lymphocyte infiltrate in the superficial dermis, which are characteristic of this condition.

rejected.label: Granuloma annulare
rejected.why: While Granuloma annulare shares some clinical features, the biopsy findings and the presence of diabetes mellitus in the patient's history more strongly support Necrobiosis Lipoidica.
